title: Complete decision tree of a function
statement: For a function from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to a set of outputs, construct the decision tree that starts with every coordinate available and the all-zero input, querying the least available coordinate at each step and branching on its two possible values; each terminal leaf is labelled by the function value at the resulting input.
hypotheses_covered: a function from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to an output type
